name: Mosonszolnok (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow yellow horizontal stripe near the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mosonszolnok: a blue shield with a white bird and a bunch of grapes, with a helm and grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mosonszolnok arms with helm and mantling
